findings.headline: 99215 on 24.1% of claims vs 3.7%... expected 1.5%; 93% of 99215s on patients with 0-1 conditions; all 3 sampled 99215 charts documented at moderate MDM
findings.interpretation: Claims: 99215 share 24.1% vs expected 1.5% (risk-adjusted 13.4). 53 of 57 99215s were on patients with 0-1 chronic conditions (e.g., R21, N39.0, J06.9). Random sample of 30 charts came back complete: all 3 documented 99215 claims were at moderate MDM, below billed (C0102072, C0102232, C0102315; peer rate 0%), and 1 of 19 99214s was documented low (C0102322). Overpayment estimate from the random sample: $2,469 (CI $2,169-$2,769). Caveat: only 3 documented 99215s, so a certified coder needs to re-score before any recovery.

findings.headline: 3 of 7 sampled 99215 charts documented below billed level (peer 0%); 99215 share 20.7% vs 3.7% expected
findings.interpretation: Risk-adjusted score 6.6; 39% of 99215s on patients with 0-1 conditions. In a complete random sample of 30, 3 of 7 documented 99215s were at moderate MDM (C0081678, C0081799, C0081822), and 5 of 21 notes claiming moderate+ data review had no lab or test line on the claim. Overpayment estimate $1,068 (CI $344-$1,791). Small panel (237 claims) and small n, so this needs coder re-review. Correction to the draft summary: C0081673 was documented at high MDM (it supports the bill), and C0081694 was not one of the returned charts. Neither should be cited as below-billed evidence.

findings.headline: Very high 99215 share on healthy patients, but the notes match the bill; some notes describe data review the claims do not show
findings.interpretation: 99215 share 24.4% vs 1.9% expected (risk-adjusted 12.2); 78% of 99215s on patients with 0-1 conditions, many for URI (J06.9) or abdominal pain. The first response was unsigned notes. After follow-up, all 30 charts came back signed. All 14 documented 99215s are at high MDM, but 7 of 26 notes claiming moderate+ data review have no lab/test on the claim, which suggests notes may be inflated to match the bill (e.g., C0034724: 30-year-old, URI, high MDM, 50 minutes). 2 of 11 99214s were documented low. The charts are weak support, and there is no direct evidence of billing above the documented level. Top priority for independent coder re-scoring. Not sent to recovery.
